question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Circumstance
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Circumstance"** means a fact or condition connected with or relevant to an event or action. (परिस्थिति)

 
 
• **Example: **Due to unforeseen **circumstances**, the meeting has been postponed.
 
 
 
• **"Accident"** refers to an unfortunate incident that happens unexpectedly and unintentionally, typically resulting in damage or injury. (दुर्घटना)
 
 
• **Example: **She broke her leg in a skiing **accident.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **'Circumstance'** is **'Accident'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Superficial** (सतही): Existing or occurring at or on the surface.

 
 
• **Example:** The injury was only superficial and didn't require any stitches.
 
 
 
• **Plan** (योजना): A detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.
 
 
• **Example: **We need a solid plan to overcome these challenges.
 
 
 
• **Whole** (पूरा): All of; entire.
 
 
• **Example:** She spent the whole day cleaning the house.
